source.doc_type: CAR disclosure with reviewed condensed interim financial statements 2Q2025 (Thai)

notes: Quarterly (6 months to 30 June 2025 = year to date). First IFRS 17 interim year (2567 comparatives restated). Scanned; read locally, pages located by their headings (file page numbers). CAR disclosure p.1-3, reviewed interim statements from p.4 (auditor PwC). Thousand Baht. SCI three months p.7, six months p.9. Revenue and expenses 24.1 (p.82, printed sideways; columns non-PAA / PAA / total, six months, both years): incurred claims and acquisition amortisation include PAA. CSM roll-forward 19.1.2 p.72 (portrait in this edition; ยอดสุทธิ ณ วันที่ 30 มิถุนายน พ.ศ. 2568); future-service change = change in estimates + onerous line (42) + experience adjustment (CSM column). New business 19.1.3 p.74: no total column; the onerous column is nil, so the non-onerous column is the total; unlike 1Q2025 it prints the normal sign. Differences from the 1Q2025 edition, recorded as printed: (1) the opening CSM is 74,348,041 (the restated 1 January 2568 figure of the FY2025 annual statements; 1Q2025 printed 74,722,569), and the 'other changes' row of 1Q2025 is gone; (2) 24.1 now prints an acquisition-cash-flow recovery (2,335,501; nil in 1Q2025); (3) the six-month SCI restates the first quarter between investment income, other operating expenses and other income (the three-month column differs from six months less 1Q2025 by 4,833 / 308 / (5,141); net profit unaffected). Other revenue = อื่นๆ (24.1). RA release uses 24.1 (296,697), not the AOC RA (296,884). Other expense = other finance costs + other operating expenses. The three-month profit or loss is the SCI for the three months to 30 June 2568 (p.7).
